title: Typed Template Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2610.31342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fuzzing software with complex inputs has been a longstanding challenge. Traditionally, fuzzers either programmatically encode language constraints, requiring significant engineering effort, or rely on users to declare grammars and constraints. Recent LLM-based fuzzers address these drawbacks but introduce new issues. Some use LLMs for test generation, sacrificing throughput and producing invalid inputs when the LLM makes mistakes. Others rely on language-specific parsers, static analysis, and AST manipulation libraries. We introduce Typed Template Fuzzing (TTF), a lightweight LLM-based fuzzing methodology. The key idea is to use LLMs in a preprocessing step to transform seeds into typed templates. The typed templates then enable semantically aware, mutation-based fuzzing without language-specific parsers, type checkers, or further LLM queries during fuzzing. translated_abstract: 使用复杂输入对软件进行模糊测试长期以来一直是一项挑战。传统上，模糊测试器要么以编程方式对语言约束进行编码（这需要大量的工程工作），要么依赖用户来声明语法和约束。近来基于大语言模型（LLM）的模糊测试器解决了这些缺点，但也带来了新问题：一些方法使用LLM进行测试生成，牺牲了吞吐量，且当LLM出错时会产生无效输入；另一些方法则依赖于特定语言的解析器、静态分析和AST操作库。我们提出了类型化模板模糊测试（Typed Template Fuzzing，TTF），这是一种轻量级的基于LLM的模糊测试方法。其核心思想是在预处理步骤中使用LLM将种子转化为类型化模板。随后，这些类型化模板能够支持语义感知的、基于变异的模糊测试，而无需特定语言的解析器、类型检查器，也无需在模糊测试过程中进一步查询LLM。通过利用种子与模板之间的对应关系，TTF还可以（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: TTF提出了一种轻量级的基于大语言模型的模糊测试方法，通过在预处理阶段利用LLM将种子转化为类型化模板，从而无需特定语言解析器、类型检查器或模糊测试过程中的LLM查询，即可实现语义感知的高效变异式模糊测试。
en_tdlr: TTF is a lightweight LLM-based fuzzing methodology that uses LLMs in a preprocessing step to transform seeds into typed templates, enabling semantically-aware mutation-based fuzzing without language-specific parsers, type checkers, or LLM queries during fuzzing.
